summary: Documented the tested M5-S03 step (docs, owner story-drafter, 11 INVEST stories across 4 epics). Re-rendered PLAN.md/CLARIFICATIONS.md from plan.json. Appended five decisions.md entries sourced from the step's three envelopes and process_observations: O-M5S03-01 (no writer owns the REQ- sequence; REQ-052-058 adopted unchanged, no collision with REQ-051), O-M5S03-02 (no deploy-order.md on this step, per standards/build-orchestration.md § 4 'borrowing a roster agent' condition 2 — story-drafter's Output Contract names no such file), O-M5S03-03 (check_invest.py's 250-word body heuristic cannot separate an oversized story from a story correctly carrying a G4-mandated handoff note — all 10 WARNs on this backlog are the same false signal), D-M5S03-04 (story-drafter self-corrected three dangling skill-path citations before finalising the document), and O-M5S03-05 (the email channel is split into two stories, not one, because Q77 gives Billing its own named tester — an INVEST persona-drift call, not a miscount against the manual test's literal 'three channels, three stories' wording). Wrote one workbook row (CWB-OTHER-036, workbook/99-other-configuration.md — the story-backlog.md document itself; it covers none of the ten canonical sections and story-drafter's Output Contract names no package.xml/deploy-order.md, so it lands in Other configuration by the docs-type 'otherwise' clause, not the unmapped-step-type default). Wrote seven traceability.md rows (REQ-052 through REQ-058, minted by story-drafter and adopted here unchanged) plus the accompanying 'What M5-S03 rests on', 'Coverage, as far as M5-S03' and 'Linter result' sections; check_rtm.py --file traceability.md --manifest-dir artefacts --repo-root <repo> reports 58 rows, 0 orphans, 0 errors, 4 warnings (the four Draft rows' waived coverage gaps: REQ-055-058). Set M5-S03 to documented via build_plan.py set-status.
confidence_rationale: The one artefact this step produced (story-backlog.md) got exactly one workbook row, every new traceability row carries a real source_req_id and a stated verification path (checker, manual, or an honestly-empty one under Draft), and no requirement the step serves is missing a row. Held at MEDIUM, not HIGH, on the Step 11 MEDIUM trigger 'an artefact could not be placed in a section without judgment': story-backlog.md does not cover any of the ten canonical workbook sections, so its placement in Other configuration rests on reading the docs-type row's 'otherwise' clause rather than a direct section match. Secondarily, four of the seven new traceability rows (REQ-055-058) carry a Draft status with a waived coverage gap rather than a clean pass — an honest reflection of what this step actually delivered, not a defect in the documentation, but not a HIGH-confidence 'every row's verification is complete' outcome either.

dimensions_skipped.reason: Every workbook row written before this step (across 01-objects-and-fields.md through 06-automation.md and this file) carries source_story_id 'pending:M5-S03', anticipating that this step would mint the story ids that could fill them in. Now that story-backlog.md exists, those ~35 cells could in principle be resolved to real US-CASE-nnn ids, but agents/build-doc-keeper/AGENT.md Step 8 rule 4 leaves rows belonging to other steps byte-identical on this run — backfilling them is not this invocation's job.
dimensions_skipped.retry_hint: A human or a dedicated pass should decide, per row, which US-CASE-nnn id (if any) now applies, and amend each row through the same replace-by-row_id mechanism the next time that row's own step is touched — not as a side effect of this run.

process_observations.observation: REQ-052 through REQ-058, minted by story-drafter inside story-backlog.md, continue cleanly from REQ-051 (the highest id traceability.md carried before this step) with no collision — the ownership gap story-drafter itself flagged as a risk did not materialize this run.

story-drafter checked every skills/... path named in the drafted backlog against the registry and corrected three that did not resolve (admin/web-to-case-and-email-to-case, admin/queue-design, apex/trigger-handler-pattern) before finalising the document, rather than shipping a dangling citation for a later reader to trip over.

All 10 WARNs check_invest.py raised on this backlog are the same 250-word body heuristic, and the three heaviest overflows are exactly the three stories carrying the F-40, completion-proxy and Q24 notes the M4 gate required be written down — the checker cannot separate an oversized story from a compliant one carrying a mandated note.

Roughly 35 workbook rows across workbook/01-*.md through workbook/06-automation.md still read source_story_id 'pending:M5-S03', now stale in the literal sense that M5-S03 has landed and minted story ids, but Step 8 rule 4 forbids updating another step's rows on this run, so the backfill is named here rather than performed.

No AGENT.md in this build assigns exclusive ownership of the REQ- id sequence to one agent; both story-drafter and build-doc-keeper are capable of minting the next id, and the two spaces did not collide this run only because story-drafter happened to read traceability.md's current highest id first.

The email intake channel is proven by two stories (US-CASE-001, US-CASE-002), not one, because Q77 gives Billing its own named tester — a reading of the M5 manual test's intent rather than its literal 'three channels, three stories' wording, which a human should confirm before this shape is compiled at M5-S04.

M5-S03 is now documented; the plan's next command surfaces M5-S04, the compile-run docs step that assembles the UAT case pack and the compiled acceptance-criteria document from this backlog's per-story criteria.
process_observations.followup_reason: because M5-S04 depends_on M5-S03 and can now enter next, and build-step-runner is what claims a pending step.

process_observations.observation: M5-S02 (sandbox strategy) remains blocked on four inputs, and REQ-058 plus every story's unnamed sandbox trace back to exactly that gap.
process_observations.followup_reason: because unblocking M5-S02 supplies the named sandbox every story in this backlog currently lacks, closing REQ-058's Draft row.
